title: Philip K. Dick's Metz speech claiming the Man in the High Castle world was real
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Philip K. Dick's Metz speech claiming the Man in the High Castle world was real, about 1977 at Metz, France, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: >> where you know he gave this famous speech uh in Mets France where he I think it was called um you know if you if you think this world sucks you should see the others or something

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, recalls a famous speech that the writer Philip K. Dick gave in 1977 in Metz, France, which Michels remembers as having a title like "if you think this world is bad, you should see the others." As the story goes, Dick claimed in that talk that the world of his book The Man in the High Castle was real, a hint that other versions of reality might exist alongside ours.
